faq-old-data-body: The Wikimedia pageviews API was introduced in August 2015 and does not include data from before that time. You will have to rely on other tools such as stats.grok.se to view data older than this. Whether or not they work is unfortunately outside the scope of this tool, and beyond the control of the maintainers.
